question:
Select the option that is related to the third fraction in the same way as the second fraction is related to the first fraction.

(1)/(4) : (1)/(8) :: (1)/(3) : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

 
• Multiply by 2 in the denominator.
 
• ​(1)/(4×2)​ = (1)/(8)

Similarly,

 
• (1)/(3×2) = (1)/(6)324" role="presentation" style="display: inline; position: relative;" tabindex="0">

Hence, "option 3" is the correct answer.
